message.subject: Add design tokens, dark mode and modern app shell (#8)
message.body:
Replace the Flowbite-style colour classes with semantic design tokens
(background, foreground, muted, primary, success, danger, border, ring)
exposed as Tailwind colours and backed by CSS variables for light and
dark themes. Dark mode is class based. A theme toggle in the header
switches between the two, and the choice is saved in localStorage.

The app shell is reworked: the header is sticky and has a mobile menu
with aria-expanded. Home shows skeleton placeholders instead of the
full-screen spinner while loading. Modals close on Escape and lock
body scroll while open.

Privacy mode now also masks monetary values in the entries table, the
mobile entries list and the forecast table, and it is passed through
to the graph modals.

- Header.astro: sticky header, mobile menu, privacy and theme toggles
- ThemeToggle.jsx: new component, uses applyTheme from lib/theme
- components/ui: new Button, Card, Badge and Skeleton primitives
- tailwind.config.mjs, global.css: semantic tokens and fadeIn animation
- BaseModal.jsx: dialog role, Escape to close, body scroll lock
- investments/*: components moved to tokens, isPrivate passed through
